function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "最新的電影上映有哪些？" meaning "What are the latest movies released?" They want a list of recent movie releases. We need to provide a list. There's no tool needed. Just answer.
